segments.text: She is the older sister of Tsukumo and a school nurse. She's quite popular among the students and teachers. A rumor says that one of her former schoolmate - a rich medical doctor - would try to go out with her. In reality, this rumor was created by Tsukumo for stopping the boys who try to going out with his sister.
She's also the subject of the sexual fantaisies of her little brother who had a secret crush on her since ever.

She's a big fan of astrology and science fiction, she reads a lot of novels and often watches documentaries on television. She is an inconsiderate fan of the physicist and professor Kagami, she owns and has read all his books.
Her favorite theme and subject is the time travel. One of her favorite writers is - among overs - Isaac Asimov.
Her passion for astrology and science fiction came from a "friend" she had in high school and who disappeared at that time. She used to call him "Onii-chan".
Given the way she talks about this "friend", he probably had to more than a simple "friend", maybe he had to be her lover.

Natsuki rejects Tsukumo because she is in love with her "friend" who has disappeared and can not love Tsukumo other than brotherly love. When he goes out with Mimi, she starts to depress and drink a bit more than before. Then, she realizes her true feelings ...

Then, she falls seriously ill due to a poison that has been circulating in her blood since she has getting hurt by rescuing Tsukumo of dying in 1999. Her death then triggers a chain of events for Tsukumo, in order to save her.
The traits corresponding to the state of her virginity have a value that varies according to the temporal line and the parallel dimension born as a result of a minor or major temporal change.
This heroine has another alternative version (from when she were even younger, in the year of 1996).

Mimi is a young girl that Tsukumo crossed a night in the street during his jogging, she searched her losting white cat nammed Sugar. Some times later, he learned she's one of his kouhai in his school.
She's the best friend and classmate of Akeno. She tends to faint after a strong emotion. She is also a very pure girl.

Since Tsukumo saved her, she talks about him as her "Ouji-savior" - because she didn't know his first name - to her best friend, Akeno, who made the connection with Tsukumo when she asked her if she knew any something else about him and she replied that she only knew his last name, Sakurazuka.
She is the daughter of Nene and of the professor Kagami, a very famous and great physicist that Tsukumo has already seen several times on television with Natsuki.

Mimi is very envious of Tsukumo and Natsuki's fraternal relationship because she is an only child and would like to know this kind of relationship. Although she doesn't seem to be very smart, Mimi is a girl who understands things very easily just by observing them. Very much in love with Tsukumo, she sees that the more time passes, the more he seems to be lost.

When she learns that Natsuki is not his biological sister, she begins to understand that Tsukumo is loving her more than a sister. When Akeno tells her that she wants to give her tickets to go to the cinema between lovers, Mimi asks her to put them in the mailbox of Tsukmo's house, waiting for his reaction. When she learns that Tsukumo gave the tickets to Natsuki, her doubts are true and she'll put - in tears - an ultimatum to the man she loves ...

If Tsukumo doesn't choose her, they separate and she has a depression because she is heartbroken. She nevertheless wishes that her senpai finds happiness on the day of tanabata ( which will affect Tsukumo enormously ).
She is the girlfriend of Sakuya and Tsukumo's friend. She's also their kouhai.
Her best friend is Bibi who is also her classmate.
She is frank and without genes. When she sees the muscles of Tsukumo when they are at the beach, she does not hesitate to touch him in front of her boyfriend, making him a little jealous.

When Sakuya tries to value himself in her eyes, she doesn't hesitate to devalue him in one or two words, especially by calling into question his night performances ( her tsun-tsun side ) ... She's easly embarassed when her boyfriend is complimenting her and she becomes very cute ( her dere-dere side ).
He is the boyfriend and senpai of Akeno and also Tsukumo's friend and classmate.
He loves very much his girlfriend, even if she's irritating sometimes ...
He's a guy who has a good background, he does not judge people about their appearance and he considers himself the first friend of Tsukumo ( which is true ).
He is the type not to get into trouble, but he draws to Tsukumo, spreading the rumor that his friend is the strongest, many offenders come to measure their strength against him.
It was he who spread the news of his rising in fame after defeating Torazou ( the current "Boss" ), renaming Tsukumo the "new Boss".

He is the leader of the gangsters of the city, known as undefeated. His "people" and others call him "Boss" because he runs a gang that rages in several schools. He considerates himself as a rival of Tsukumo.
His war symbol is a tiger.

Even if he looks extremely cold, he can be "considerate" with the people he likes. The day he learns of Natsuki-sensei's death, he breaks Tsukumo's mouth so he can get out of his depression and become strong again.
Without him, Tsukumo would not have sought - nor thought - to go back in time.
His relationship with Tsukumo - after their fight - is very similar to that of Vegeta and Goku in Dragon Ball Z.
An old acquaintance of Natsuki from high school. He is in a way his drinking partner and his confidant.
He serves as a model for Tsukumo's story of his sister's fake boyfriend.
He apparently met Tsukumo once in the past when he was younger - but Tsukumo is sure he never met him before - and he also adds that they were the same age at the time ...
It is thanks to him and his research that Tsukumo knows the cause of Natsuki's death.
He has the same last name as Takashima Kimihiko from PurexCure and Takashima Haruhiko from Koibumi Romantica; the three of them also have a similar appearance, personality AND occupation.
A suspicious and unknown woman who seems to be staring at
Tsukumo and Natsuki during one of their outings together ...
She will come to meet Tsukumo after Natsuki's death. She knows strangely well the siblings and seems to know everything. She disguises a mystical aura around her and seems unreal.
She asks Tsukumo if he wants to save his sister and she tells him that there is a way to save her and that she can help him get there.
In reality, she's Natsuki's classmate from when they were in high school. Her height is 180 cm when including the heels she usually wears.
The only man she was able to love was the "friend" of Natsuki and she still loves him.
Tsukumo was adopted when he was very young kid - in 1999 - by the Sakurazuka family following the loss of his family because of a natural disaster in 1996.

At first, he couldn't think of Natsuki as his sister until she saved him - the same year - from drowning, getting hurt herself in the process. Ever since, he has been devoting a deep love to her, more than brotherly.
Tsukumo rarely loses consciousness after a fight, even if it was a difficult fight. On the other hand, Mimi's kitchen nearly sent him to the other world ...

After rescuing Mimi from a bunch of mobsters, she declares her love for Tsukumo who tells him he will think. Tsukumo then declares his love to his sister but is rejected. He then agrees to go out with Mimi as a friend, but the more time passes, the more Mimi is in love with him. Naive but smart, Mimi understands that Tsukumo loves someone else and asks him an ultmatum ...

If Tsukumo don't see Mimi as her person only for him, he breakup with her. If he choose to have sex with Mimi but can't forget his love for Natsuki, she breakup with him. If Tsukumo choose Mimi, they stay together.
Although he doesn't see Mimi as a romantic interest, Tsukumo loves her a lot and is very angry at him for breaking her heart.
When his sister gets sick, he learns from Kirihiko that this is probably due to poisoning. He thinks she was poisoned the day she saved Tsukumo from drowning years ago.
When she dies, Tsukumo is destroyed but manages to recover thanks to his entourage and decides to save his sister from "himself" by preventing her from hurting herself in the past.
So begins his incredible journey through the Time ...
This is the same Natsuki Sakurazuka, only younger. She looked like this in the year of 1999.
On the other hand, her personality is slightly different from that of the present time because she is more reserved and timid.

She jumps on Tsukumo's neck the day of his arrival by calling him "Oni-chan". Knowing she misunderstands, Tsukumo - on the verge of being called her "Nee-san" - pretends not to know her, which makes her deeply sad. Tsukumo will finish in her class as a transferred student.
Kuurin makes her believe that Tsukumo has lost his memory.
She often comforts with Kuurin who seems to be her best friend and her confidante. She already told her about her "Onii-chan".
Even if Tsukumo is supposed to have lost his memory, she will pretend in front of her whole class that she is his girlfriend.
Some time after Kuurin will try to rob her romantic interest ( she can get there depending on the route chosen ).
The trait corresponding to the state of her virginity have a value that varies according to the temporal line and the parallel dimension born as a result of a minor or major temporal change.
She is described by her classmates as the most beautiful and kind girl in high school. The boys also call her "untouchable beauty" because she rejects all boys when they confess.
This heroine has another alternative version (from when she were even younger, in the year of 1996).
Natsuki's classmate and friend in 1999. She looks and acts cold toward men but not against women.

She and her father take care of housing Tsukumo in 1999 and provide him with what he needs. It is also them who invented an identity for him in order to infiltrate the society of 1999, it will now be for the outside world "Nagi Tsukumo". Kuurin's role is to be his "guardian", she will pretend to be his non-blood-related sister.

She is idolized at her high school, called "Onee-sama" by her classmates ( Tsukumo will be called "Onii-sama" because it is supposed to be her brother ). She takes advantage of her notoriety to seduce girls in order to have sex with them.
Her personality is quite similar to what she has in the present time, although she looks more ... explosive and bitter.
She is stronger than Tsukumo in singular combat.
She makes fun of him by calling him "Saru" ( monkey ) and because he is a huge siscon, calling his sister in his sleep.
Her favorite perfume is vanilla.

She has been the victim of horrible events in the past - who are at the origin of her hatred towards men - and makes nightmares about these events every time she falls asleep, but doesn't really remember in what she was afraid when she wakes up in panic.
Despite all of this, she looks to appreciate Tsukumo or she just considerates him better than the other men she despises.
The trait "Sex with Others" concerns her and Yurika because they sleep together.
There maybe other girls with whom she sleeps in off screen but not with boys.
Kuurin's millionaire father.

Kuurin isn't his real daughter, he adopted her after the disaster of 1996, when he met her in a hospital. At that time, Kuuri was completely amnesiac, however, no man could approach her because she was having hysterics crisis at their simple mere sight.
Her body had traces of wounds caused by men, spread over a very long time. She had to be beaten.
They thinked she was probably "raped" several times in the past too.

Having forgotten her rape, his daughter continues to make nightmares every nights of her atrocious moments, but doesn't know and remember why when she wakes up in panic. He confided to Tsukumo his disengagement because he can not help her.

segments.text: A classmate of Natsuki in 1999.
It was at this time that she met onii-chan for the first time. It was also at that time that she found an abandoned baby.
This is Natsuki in the year of 1996. There are two versions of her in the game when she is older: one from the year of 1999, and one from the present.
Nana is professor Kagami's wife and Mimi's mother at the time when she was pregnant with her, in the year of 1996.
A young mother who has just had her baby whom Natsuki meets in the outside courtyard of the hospital and who is hospitalized because she has cancer, they will get along fairly quickly.
She is good advice and will help Natsuki reorder her feelings.
A great physicist who has worked a lot on the time travel of which Natsuki is a fan and who often goes into the documentaries she watches.
It's Nene's husband and Mimi's dad.

His passion for time traveling would come from a person he met in the past and who always ordered at a cafe the "back menu", a shrimp avocado bowl. He sometimes continues this little tradition when he goes to the same cafe today.
His research and works served as bases for the construction of the Nagi family's time machine.

segments.text: He is the father of Natsuki and Tsukumo.
He left with his wife to take over a family business outside the city in the present time and no longer live in the family home. They come back from time to time to visit their children.
They are much more present in the past because they work in the city and not outside (because they have not yet taken over the family business).
She is the mother of Natsuki and Tsukumo.
She left with her husband to take over a family business outside the city in the present time and no longer live in the family home. They come back from time to time to visit their children.
They are much more present in the past because they work in the city and not outside (because they have not yet taken over the family business).
Yurika is a kouhai and the girlfriend of Kuurin in 1999.
She idolizes Kuurin and she is deeply in love with her, but we do not know if Kuurin really regarded her as her girlfriend or as a one night stand partner.
As they are about to make love, Yurika tells Yuurin that she has changed because of this "damn boy" and is very jealous.
She's afraid Kuurin will leave her for him.
The trait "Sex with Others" only concerns her and Kuurin because they sleep together.
Tsukumo when he arrives in his new family in 1999.

The Tsukumo from present attends to his own introduction into the family when he goes in 1999. He took the opportunity to ask his parents at the time why he adopted a boy violent and lonely and gets answers that warms his heart.
Mimi in 1999.
The delinquant leader in 1996 and 1999, seems to want some bad things to Tsukumo.
His war symbol is a dragon.
He is the older brother of Torazou, He died in a motorcycle accident 3 years before the "present time".
It is for this reason that Torazou understands Tsukumo's sorrow when his sister dies and seeks to help him.
He is the onii-chan from Natsuki's timeline ( when she is an adult and a virgin ) she met in her childhood.
He is an alternative version of the protagonist, his history is a quite different. He also lived the same things as in the first chapter but with variations :

For exemple, he don't know the existence of Mimi because she never existed in his timeline and the events he lived such the rescue of Mimi becomes - for him - the rescue of Akeno ( who takes her place in his story ).

When he returns in the past for saving his sister from her injury in 1999 and when he comes back in the present timeline, his sister was with another "himself", the one from the timeline of the Natsuki of 1999 who never has to seek to travel back in time in order to save his sister.
His return to the present makes him exist in duplicate. And that's not the only thing that has changed.

Some people he knew are completely different, their lives are different. His brain contains two versions of his memories, those of events that have been known since the beginning of the game and new ones that are parallel.
Tsukumo's mission is far from over and he decides to go back in time with "Doc" in 1996 ...
Being the same Tsukumo that the player controls since the beginning of the game, he keeps all the attributes of his counterpart, just his way of dressing changes.
He's the protagonist of the third chapter only.
The doctor that only Tsukumo knows his existence ...
He lost his wife and daughter in the disaster of 1996 and work with Tsukumo for their respectives interests.
They help each other to reach their goals.
He has many and different memories on Tsukumo but with variations. He remembers a Tsukumo with a yellow bandanna and another with a green bandanna.
He realizes that their time travel can also be interdimensional, and that he and Tsukumo may not be the first versions of themselves to travel back in time and exceed the dimensional limits.
He then develops his theory on "The complexity of Time" ...

The Natsuki that Tsukumo finds alongside another... Tsukumo. In this temporality, Tsukumo ("Onii-san") managed to save Natsuki from her accident, however he finds himself in "double copy" in his temporality (present time). He then decides not to interact with them so as not to destroy the temporal flow (or something like that) but a fight between his other him, Natsuki (who loses consciousness) and thugs force him to intervene.
Being the same Natsuki that the player knows since the beginning of the game, she keeps all the attributes of her counterpart, just her role and her health state changes.
Seen only in the third chapter.

Being the same Tsukumo that the player controls since the beginning of the game, he keeps all the attributes of his counterpart, just his role changes.

He has the name and appearance of Oneyama Genta from PurexCure. Despite that, these characters are two different people because PurexCure and Koibumi Romantica are set in different times. (Koibumi Romantica's events are happening at least 50 years before the events in PurexCure.)
He seems to be the martial master of Tsukumo in Astraythem because he called him "Master".
